title: Seventeen Sparks
description: A toy workshop after closing: a music box tries to say a whole haiku in seventeen notes, a spring laser answers it in the silence it leaves, and the clay pot and the log keep time until it is gone.

sections.development: half a hook: the first two lines, cold
still half; the laser answers in the gap
stop-time, then nothing: the last line is withheld
the whole poem: the last line arrives, the owner heats, the room stays put
